prompt: My agent has no Sendmux key. It wants to create its own inbox, read incoming mail, and invite me as the owner so I can later approve sending. What sequence should it follow?
assertions: The output runs sendmux agent:register with a profile name and optionally --owner-email.
The output says no existing account, API key, challenge, or proof of work step is required.
The output says the CLI saves registration idempotency before the registration request, securely stores the returned durable credential in the local profile, and never prints the credential.
The output says the profile can read and receive mail without an expiry date while the registration remains active.
The output runs sendmux agent:invite-owner when an owner was not invited during registration.
The output states that storage is capped at 500 MiB before owner approval and raised to at least 5 GiB with sending approval.
The output waits for owner acceptance and sending approval.
The output says Sending CLI commands automatically exchange and cache a one-hour delegated token after approval.
